svg.title: Eight orange tile input and output port layouts
svg.text: Orange tiles — all eight bottom/top port layouts
Circle = 0. Plus = 1. C0/C1 preserves the repeated middle input using a separate connector type.
Both faces shown in assembly coordinates from above: port positions align vertically; the underside is not mirrored.
Position geometry derived from the blue face
Proposed body: 4L/5 × L/5. Port pitch: L/5. End margins: L/10. Four ports centred across the width.
Local port centres along length: L/10, 3L/10, 5L/10, 7L/10. All lie on the midline L/10.
C0/C1 are labels here: their actual raised/recessed profiles and channel heights still need to be drawn.
